description: JavaScript functions for client-side validation and form handling in a web application, including input length validation, password confirmation, field focus management, error display, whitespace checking, and textarea character counting.

methods.name: valTextLength
methods.description: Validates the length of a form field against min and max limits, providing user alerts and visual feedback.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Checks if two password fields have matching values, clearing and focusing if they do not match.

methods.name: selectField
methods.description: Focuses and highlights a specific form field within a form, attaching onchange event handlers.

methods.name: errorDetails
methods.description: Displays or hides error indicators and highlights for a form field.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a string is empty or contains only whitespace characters.

methods.name: checkErrorCondition
methods.description: Validates form fields based on type, updating error display and executing old onchange handlers.

methods.name: hasOneSelected
methods.description: Checks if at least one option is selected in a multi-select form field.

methods.name: getSelectedOption
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the selected option in a select element.

methods.name: getSelectedOptionObject
methods.description: Retrieves the selected option object from a select element.

methods.name: getFormElement
methods.description: Retrieves a specific form element by name and index.

methods.name: getPageElement
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM element by ID.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves a form element by name.

methods.name: textCounter
methods.description: Limits textarea input length and updates a character counter display.
